_comment: Filled in by the release process before publishing (SPEC.md §7: 'Record the exact owner/repo in the package at release time; init writes that literal into the workflow. Do not leave <this-github-repo> as a placeholder in generated YAML.'). checkoutSha pins actions/checkout to an exact upstream commit SHA. actionOwner/actionRepo/reviewActionSha identify THIS package's own public repo and pin its actions/review path to the commit being released — never the repo init is installing into.
